🇩🇪 A1 GERMAN VOCABULARY: Schule (At school)

der Stift = pen
der Bleistift = pencil
der Radiergummi = eraser
die Tafel = board
der Rucksack = backpack
die Schule = school

💡 Tip: Learn der/die/das with every noun.
